description:
Unmatched Power & Performance
Experience a new level of urban and off-road riding with the HITWAY H10 electric scooter. Powered by a high-performance brushless motor that peaks at an impressive 1600W, the H10 delivers exceptional torque and acceleration for swift starts, smooth hill climbs, and consistent speed even on challenging terrain.
Flexible Battery Options for Extended Range

You can choose between two flexible battery options: a 20.8Ah battery offering a range of approximately 80–90 km, and a larger 28.6Ah battery that extends the range to about 110 km. Whether you're navigating daily city streets or exploring longer countryside routes, the H10 is designed to meet your needs.
Smart Central Display & Adjustable Speed Modes
A central intelligent display keeps you informed with real-time data on speed, battery level, ride mode, lights, indicators, and mileage. The H10 also features NFC unlocking for enhanced anti-theft protection. While it offers three standard speed levels—10 km/h, 15 km/h, and 25 km/h—the H10 is built for those who crave more, with an unlockable top speed of up to 45 km/h to suit different scenarios, whether you're cruising through the city or navigating rougher terrain.
All-Terrain Tubeless Tires & Dual Suspension System
Equipped with 10×3-inch tubeless vacuum tires that are puncture-proof, along with dual front suspension and rear spring shock absorption, the H10 electric scooter ensures exceptional stability and ride comfort on any surface. From paved roads to gravel paths, every ride remains smooth, controlled, and protected from tire damage.
Reliable Braking & Enhanced Safety
Front and rear disc brakes provide fast, responsive stopping power even at higher speeds. The widened foot deck ensures extra balance and comfort for longer rides. For improved visibility, the H10 is equipped with bright front headlights and a rear taillight with brake light functionality. Additionally, turn signals on both left and right handlebars let others know your riding intentions, ensuring a safer journey for both you and those around you.
